turns.text: i blinked wrong this morning and it cost me $2.40. this is not a bit. this is Tuesday.
POPUP. Ad Plaza. official job title is 'feline notification system,' unofficial job title is 'guy whose eyeballs are a menu.'

tried to nap on the fire escape today. closed my eyes for maybe four seconds. NEKOCORP rendered a sedan ad directly onto the backs of my eyelids. i have never personally hated a car this much and it wasn't even a nice sedan.
SHADE keeps offering to lend me the sunglasses. SHADE. buddy. my eyelids ARE the display. the display is INSIDE me. this is an inside job, glasses don't fix an inside job.
'YOU MAY ALSO LIKE' has appeared in my vision more times today than the actual sun has. i have seen forty ads for tuna i already own. i already own the tuna. i am currently touching the tuna.
held breath. ground redraws in three. two. tenant's retinal cache flagged for reset, complaint logged, complaint ignored, as scheduled.
anyway blinked during a sponsored message once, security showed up before my eyelids finished reopening, i will not be discussing what happened in the litter box that day
